verification_report.summary: Correct within the fact's stated scope. The stage-3 artifact proves planar-interface perfect matching for the stretched-coordinate Maxwell-Debye model by keeping the Debye law as (1+tau s)P=chi E and applying S_i^{-1} only to spatial derivatives; at an x-interface with S_y=1 the PML normal symbol satisfies nu=S_x nu0 and the admittance equals the physical admittance. The ADE realization of S_i^{-1}=s/(s+sigma_i) yields the displayed auxiliary variables, and differentiating the naive physical Debye energy gives the negative Debye dissipation term plus the memory couplings E(psi_E,x-psi_E,y)-H_x psi_Hx,y+H_y psi_Hy,x. Those auxiliary couplings have no definite sign in the physical energy alone, so the v2 monotone identity does not transfer to the exact stretched-coordinate ADE system. The same artifact and the prior accepted verification support that only the reduced normal-incidence 1D monotone identity is proved, while the full 2D monotone augmented/passive-memory energy remains an identified gap rather than a claimed theorem.
